about: AI Office Overview is AI Head Office Overview's office without the project tools. Read by tools/head-office-check.mjs. swaps: [Head Office's words, this app's words], applied to Head Office's files before comparing. files: per file, what each known difference is (status keep, port or ours) and its lines (written by --accept).

onlyHere.public/setup.js: Setup window (Head Office: settings.js, which also holds the project settings)
onlyHere.src/update.mjs: Update button for a git clone
onlyHere.test/server.test.mjs: this app's own server (server.mjs; Head Office's is lib/)

onlyHeadOffice.public/app.ico: Head Office's Windows shortcut icon (install helpers)
onlyHeadOffice.public/checks.js: project tools: audit, git and live-site checks
onlyHeadOffice.public/projects.js: project tools: Projects tab, Run / Stop
onlyHeadOffice.public/settings.js: Settings window with project settings (the office part is still to port: Setup as tabs)
onlyHeadOffice.src/tokens.mjs: project tools: token counts per project
onlyHeadOffice.test/tokens.test.mjs: project tools: token counts per project

missing: Star beside the name on a person's card (Head Office public/app.js personStar, projectStar)
Setup as tabs, opened from a gear button, with About and Quit (Head Office public/settings.js, office part only)
Demo office: a made-up office to try every reward (Head Office demo/, start-demo.cmd, Office bonus)
Install helpers: Start menu shortcut and uninstall (Head Office install.cmd, uninstall.cmd)
Per-run page key: every request carries a key made when the office starts (Head Office index.html aho-key, app.js api())

sun / moon / auto switch, Setup > Update and the window rules sit in other places in the file
"Show general chit-chat" tick wording (Head Office says Hide); TOMLIN in two comments; select styled in Setup
stars beside the name (.star-btn, .name-heading) and Windows icon font + gear button (.ic, .icon-btn): with the missing features below
